_about: Colour family (docs/DESIGN.md §2) of every breed that is not in the 30-breed table of DESIGN.md §2, which stays the source for those 30. Family is an editorial choice per breed, not a datum: the draft follows the breed type and FCI group first, then the Parker clade, and leans on the 30 choices Paul already made (Akita and Chow Chow ancient, Miniature Schnauzer and Pinscher terrier, Saint Bernard and Rottweiler mastiff). Drafted with Claude Code on 2026-11-09; every entry is reviewed=false until Paul checks it.
